outcome: significant dilatation of the left and right coronary arteries
no evidence of heart failure or myocardial ischemia
cohort: A full-term infant admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit.
finding: An echocardiogram revealed significant dilatation of the left and right coronary arteries without other cardiac anomalies, with normal biventricular systolic function and no signs of heart failure or myocardial ischemia.
